listings.name: Yellow Tower - Office Space
listings.address: No. 191, Tonle Sap (Rd.), Sangkat Chroy Changva, Khan Chroy Changva, Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: a vertical-forest building on the Chroy Changvar peninsula — fresh air, constant breeze, natural light and open-plan offices with minimum traffic. The out-of-city location is the point: deep-work flow, generous shared spaces, huge balconies, tall floors with mezzanines — arguably the best value in town. Reach it by ferry from the riverfront or via the Japanese Friendship Bridge.

listings.name: Regus Business Centre (Cambodia) Co., Ltd.
listings.address: No. 315, Preah Monivong Blvd (93), Canadia Tower, 18th Floor, 12202 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: the global serviced-office brand with three Phnom Penh locations including Exchange Square — coworking from $349/mo. The safe corporate choice for a landing team that needs to be operational on day one.

listings.name: Mekong Space
listings.address: No. 191, Tonle Sap (Rd.), Building Yellow Tower, Sangkat Chroy Changvar, Khan Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: coworking and private offices inside Yellow Tower from $88/mo — river views, abundant natural light, in Chroy Changvar's greenest building. A calm, nature-wrapped alternative to the downtown towers.

listings.name: The Helix Office
listings.address: No. 113, Preah Monivong Blvd. (93), Sangkat Monorom, Khan 7 Makara, 120305 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: Grade B serviced offices on Monivong Boulevard — a 45 sqm office from $1,260/mo with furniture, bi-weekly cleaning, receptionist, IT support and meeting-room hours baked in. A turnkey HQ at a fraction of Grade A rents.

listings.name: Emerald HUB
listings.address: St. 169, PPIU Building, 11th Floor, Sangkat Veal Vong, Khan 7 Makara, Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: high-rise coworking on the 11th floor with 24/7 member access and 100 Mbps wifi — day pass $10, monthly $80–150. Central, affordable, and built for nomads and small remote teams.

listings.name: Vattanac Capital
listings.address: No. 66, Preah Monivong Blvd (93), 12202 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: rising 187.3m — the country's first skyscraper and its most prestigious commercial address. Grade A offices in the emerging financial district, designed and built to international standards.

listings.name: Canadia Tower
listings.address: No. 315, Preah Ang Duong (St. 110), corner of Preah Monivong (St. 93), 12202 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: Cambodia's first high-rise and a Grade A icon of the skyline — the country's tallest building until 2014. Prime CBD junction position, offices from about $29/sqm, open 24 hours.

listings.name: Phnom Penh Tower
listings.address: No. 445, Preah Monivong Blvd (93), corner of St. 232, 12258 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: a 22-storey, 97m Grade A tower on Monivong Boulevard, completed 2011 — home to multinationals and professional services firms. A landmark address clients can actually find.

listings.name: Phnom Penh Center
listings.address: Samdech Sothearos Blvd (3), corner of Sihanouk (St. 274), 12301 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: business-centre-format offices on Sothearos Boulevard with 24-hour customer service — the practical middle ground between a serviced-office brand and a raw tower lease.

listings.name: Soma Tower
listings.why_it_stands_out: an independent office tower on Vivadhapura Street, on the 7 Makara fringe — a steady option outside the Monivong premium corridor.

listings.name: Raintree Cambodia
listings.address: No. 229, Preah Ang Duong (St. 110), 12202 Phnom Penh
listings.why_it_stands_out: Cambodia's first creative office development — "Best Office Development, Cambodia" at the International Property Awards. Five floors of bright, flexible workspace plus a rooftop terrace, for companies that want design-led space with community.

listings.name: Workspaces at Botanico
listings.why_it_stands_out: a workspace concept inside the Botanico gastrobar venue in BKK1 — cafe and kitchen hospitality built in, open 10am to midnight daily. The lifestyle end of the spectrum.

industry_notes.question: How much does office space cost in Phnom Penh?
industry_notes.answer: Across the 12 verified options above: coworking from about $88/month (Mekong Space), or $80–150/month with a $10 day pass (Emerald HUB); serviced offices from $349/month (Regus); a 45 sqm serviced office around $1,260/month with furniture, bi-weekly cleaning, receptionist, IT support and meeting-room hours included (The Helix Office); Grade A tower space from about $29/sqm (Canadia Tower). Treat these as observed points across the listed options, not market averages.

industry_notes.question: What is the difference between Grade A towers, serviced offices and coworking?
industry_notes.answer: Grade A towers — Vattanac Capital (187.3m, the country’s first skyscraper), Canadia Tower and Phnom Penh Tower — are international-standard buildings on the Monivong Boulevard corridor, home to multinationals and professional firms: landmark addresses at premium rents. Serviced offices (Regus, The Helix, Phnom Penh Center) bundle furniture, reception, cleaning and IT into one monthly price with flexible terms — turnkey space, operational on day one. Coworking and creative spaces (Mekong Space, Emerald HUB, Raintree Cambodia, Botanico) sell desks and community by the day or month — the affordable, flexible end.

industry_notes.question: Where are the main office areas in Phnom Penh?
industry_notes.answer: Preah Monivong Boulevard is the CBD corridor — Vattanac Capital, Canadia Tower, Phnom Penh Tower, The Helix and Regus all sit on or just off it. BKK1 is the lifestyle district (Workspaces at Botanico). Chroy Changvar, across the Tonle Sap — reached by ferry from the riverfront or via the Japanese Friendship Bridge — is the greener, better-value side of the river (Yellow Tower, Mekong Space).

industry_notes.question: What should I compare before signing?
industry_notes.answer: What “all-in” actually includes varies widely. The Helix lists its bundle explicitly — furniture, bi-weekly cleaning, receptionist, IT support, meeting-room hours. Regus sells flexibility across three city locations including Exchange Square. Compare the bundle line by line, not just the headline rent.
